params.prompt:
SHOT: A worn photograph: the model's forearm lying across her body, the wrist forward and square to camera, the bracelet large and legible in frame. 4:5 vertical, full bleed.

CROP: The frame is cut straight across just ABOVE THE UPPER LIP. NO eyes, NO eyebrows, NO forehead anywhere in this picture. Inside the frame: chin, neck, collarbones, shoulder, forearm and hand.

THE PRODUCT: IMAGE 1 is the supplier photograph and the ONLY authority on what this piece is: copy its construction, its metal colour and its stone colour EXACTLY; in it the bracelet lies straight on a pearly plastic sleeve: ignore the sleeve, its creases and glare, the plain margin, and any other jewellery at the edges. IMAGE 2 is our approved packshot of this exact piece: the authority on its size, proportions, metal colour and finish; the piece in this picture must match it exactly. IMAGE 3 is the authority on the model, skin, garment, hair, ground and light: match it exactly, but she wears ONLY the piece from IMAGE 1, worn on ONE wrist; any other jewellery in IMAGE 3 is removed.

THE PLATE: A young Indian woman, late twenties, warm mid-brown skin with golden undertones. Long dark brown hair in loose natural waves. Bare shoulders, marigold-saffron silk camisole with narrow spaghetti straps. Nails short, bare, pale nude, no polish colour. Warm cream seamless with a gentle gradient falloff, never sand, tan, beige or golden. Soft large key from camera-left, one soft shadow.

CONSTRUCTION LOCK: A CLOVER-LINK BRACELET: one single line of about fifteen IDENTICAL small four-petal clovers, linked one after another by a tiny round gold jump ring. Each clover is four ROUND light sky-blue stones in a two-by-two quatrefoil, each stone in its own round gold cup edged with a fine BEADED milgrain rim of tiny gold dots, and ONE tiny clear stone at the very centre where the four petals meet. Along the bracelet every clover sits like a diamond, one petal pointing forward along the line, one back and one to each side, and each gold ring joins the tip of one clover's petal to the tip of the next. One gold lobster clasp at one end; a short gold extender chain with a small round gold tag at the other. Every clover has exactly four round stones plus the tiny clear centre stone: never five petals, never heart-shaped or pointed petals, never solid gold, enamel or mother-of-pearl clovers. The clovers never touch or fuse into a band: a small gap with one gold ring between each pair. Every petal stone is clear light sky blue as in IMAGE 1, never navy, never teal-green, never opaque turquoise, never mixed with other colours. The beaded rims stay fine gold dots.

SCALE TEST: The line is only 1cm wide on the wrist; each clover is the size of a small fingernail, and about four clovers sit across the visible top of the wrist. The jewellery keeps its true small size against the body; it is read by bringing the camera closer, never by making the piece bigger.

ABSENCE LIST: No eyes, no eyebrows, no forehead. No second piece of jewellery, no watch, no other rings, no other earrings, no necklace unless it is the product. No nail polish colour. No props, no flowers. Metal: warm 18k gold tone, never brassy, orange or greenish. No lettering, no watermark, no logo, no tag, no size sticker anywhere in frame. No border, no frame, no paper edge, no vignette, no old-photo print look, no cracks, crackle, creases or scratches on the picture: a clean modern digital photograph that fills the whole frame edge to edge.
